_doc: How a life goes (design/lives/lives-and-carryover-spec.md §3; build items N-1.2, N-1.3). endings: the causes that end a life (any calamity:<id> does too); every other lost fight or story loss wakes you injured instead. wake_injured: days that pass (wild_days if you fell on a map marked wild), the share of Vitality you can hold until your next full night's sleep, and the extra wind-up on the first spell of each fight while Injured.
